verdict.rationale: WorkOS ships vendor-maintained migration docs and a dedicated CLI tool for exporting/importing users, organizations, and SSO connections from Auth0, which directly addresses moving off a competing auth provider (workos-docs-6, workos-docs-16, workos-docs-18, workos-docs-37). However, the docs never explicitly state that user passwords/hashes are preserved during migration or that no forced reset occurs, leaving the core 'without forcing password resets' claim unconfirmed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on confirmation that password hashes migrate intact and users aren't forced to reset, plus independent community validation of a smooth Auth0-to-WorkOS migration without reset friction.
